::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payments_analytics"}
#docs
The payments counterpart to `/analytics` (which is subscription revenue). Measures what the gateways did over a CALENDAR period resolved in the business timezone, each with its comparable previous period: gross volume, refunds, chargebacks, net volume, transaction count, successful payments, failed transactions/amount, failure rate (basis points) and pending payment intents — plus breakdowns by error cause, payment method and gateway. Same series shape as `/analytics` (`headline` + `points[]`), so one UI block consumes both. Aggregated in SQL.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `range` | `string` | no | Calendar-relative period; boundaries resolve in the business timezone. Weeks start on the business's `week_start` (default Sunday). |
| `currency` | `string` | no | `ALL` for the FX-converted roll-up, or a currency code to scope every figure (money AND counts) to it |
| `gateway` | `string` | no | Filter to one `gateway_key` (`unknown` selects rows with none) |
| `payment_method` | `string` | no | Filter to one payment-method type — card / upi / … (`unknown` selects rows with none) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `business_payments_analytics`. One of `business_payments_analytics`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the figures were computed. |
| `range` | `string` | The selected range. |
| `timezone` | `string` | The business time zone. |
| `granularity` | `string` | The bucket size of the series. |
| `period` | `object` | The selected period. |
| `previous_period` | `object` | The period that the figures compare against. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of the money figures. |
| `converted` | `boolean` | True if the figures are converted into `currency`. |
| `available_currencies` | `array of string` | Currencies you can select. |
| `missing_rates` | `array of string` | Currencies that have no exchange rate and are left out. |
| `filters` | `object` | The filters that apply. |
| `options` | `object` | The values you can filter on. |
| `series` | `array of object` | The metric time-series. |
| `breakdowns` | `object` | The breakdowns. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Business payments analytics |
| `400` | Invalid range |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payments_analytics" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
